learning_outcomes.text: Work productively across Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and Forms
Communicate and manage work in Gmail, Chat and Spaces
Coordinate with Google Calendar and Meet
Organize, share and control access to files in Google Drive
Collaborate in real time with comments, suggestions and version history
Apply sharing, permission and basic security practices across Workspace
Use Gemini assistance appropriately and verify its output
Choose the right Workspace tool for a given business task

integrative_case: Run a product launch in Google Workspace: draft the plan in Docs with suggesting mode, track tasks in Sheets, build the deck in Slides, collect sign-ups with Forms, schedule the review in Calendar with a Meet link, and organize everything in a shared Drive with correct access levels.
